title: Your Wardens ARE the maze.
note: Hand-built maze (capture --map, seed 4242, obstacles edge): three walls alternating bottom/top/bottom (the outer two jog a half cell at the middle, the middle one zigzags a half cell every piece), a cap over the glade, an east wall and a sill so the route reaches the Heartwood from the side; Sporelings on the bends. 46 Thornwall + 5 Sporeling spots, 50 Wardens planted (one spot is taken), route ~18 -> 70 cells. screenshot_01 uses the same spots in the same order.
captions: Every Warden bends the path the nightmares walk.
Fifty Wardens in: four times the path.
Then I hit start. They walk every bend of it.
